name: Mount Paektu
story: Mount Paektu is an active stratovolcano on the Chinese-North Korean border. At 2,744 m tall, it is the highest mountain in North Korea and Northeast China, and features a caldera containing Heaven Lake. Long snowy winters and volcanic soil support larch, birch, and Korean pine forests.
matters: The mountain is a known habitat for Siberian tigers, Asian black bears, Mongolian wolves, and wild boars. Its broad-leaved and Korean pine forests preserve ancient structural characteristics of the Tertiary plant community and maintain ecological security in northeastern China.
